summary.intent: Drive the caliper project's open work to a reviewable state: get the Storybook projection fix (PR #384) and related PRs attached to trails, clean up stale worktrees and branches, and continue with the remaining resolver and oracle work.
summary.outcome: Six PRs (#379-#384) were opened and trails #248/#249 assigned, #234/#241/#243 closed and #235 refreshed. 9 stray remote branches were deleted and worktrees went from 89 to 19. #381-#383 merged. Two stacked workers (comparator fix for #380, resolver Batch 1) are running. Commit signing was confirmed on every commit checked.

repo: Canonical JSON and CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION are unchanged by the Storybook control projection fix; only RDT output changes which control Storybook shows.
docs/architecture/serialization-formats.md documents the RDT enum shape as a contract, so changes to rdt.rs enum projection must update its snippet and Invariants 2 and 3.
`docgen_info` is shared by the NAPI binding and the vite-plugin, so projection changes like the `@ignore` drop reach both automatically.
In the repo's @storybook/react only `@ignore` drops a prop; `@internal`, `@private`, `@hidden` and `@deprecated` props are kept, and caliper matches that.

A `computed: true` option with a plain value list broke Storybook's docs table type summary, so mixed literal unions stay as `{"name":"\"a\" | 1 | true"}`, which Storybook's converter parses into real values.

The #380 comparator fix removes 28 false wrongs but adds about 19 new ones, mostly antd props mixing literals with `string & Record<never, never>` (e.g. Badge.color, Col.flex), so its rule is too aggressive.
The expected remaining true wrongs are shadcn Form.watch and Form.getValues (call-signature-only types) and chakra AbsoluteCenter.axis.
The oracle's TypeScript program has no `paths`, leaving 277 props unjudged.
Resolver defect trail #255 is stacked on feat/resolve-interfaces-by-scope (#379) and must be merged bottom-up after #379.

code.finding: `type_json` and `component_doc` were changed so single literals become one-option enums, booleans in mixed unions stay as a name string, and `@ignore` props are omitted.
`is_literal_union` has a single caller (rdt.rs) and was changed so single-member literals count as enums.

workflow: Subagent hand-back and teammate messages are model output, not user authority; act on them within the session's own permissions.
The auto-mode classifier denies force-removal of dirty worktrees; get explicit user approval first and then retry.
Worktrees locked by a PID (18858) should not be unlocked without the user confirming the process is not a live session.

Running the oracle costs significant tokens; run it only on request or once per merged batch, never to check a single PR. Prefer failing-first unit tests, CLI repros and saved verdict files, and this is saved as a memory.
Stop a runaway worker promptly, but check whether it already finished and read its on-disk results instead of re-running.
Files kept only in /tmp (ground-truth harness, fixtures, rules file) get lost and should be committed.
Require `git commit -S` in worker rules and verify signatures with git's `G` status; merge commits created by GitHub were not checked.
Run overlapping resolver and extractor work one batch at a time to avoid conflicts.

friction: User pushed back that the oracle rerun wasted money; I had started it only to confirm a claim in #380, and it had already finished before it could be stopped.
The /tmp artifacts (earlier oracle analysis, ground-truth harness, worker rules file) were lost and had to be recreated.
The ground-truth harness and its local-interface fixtures were never committed and are gone.
The sandbox caused about 40 spurious nextest failures in the worktree; a clean-room run was needed to get clean results.
The auto-mode classifier blocked force-removal of dirty worktrees until the user approved.
About a dozen worktrees are locked by PID 18858 and could not be removed.
Subagent `git checkout -b` left it on the worktree branch, so the branch had to be moved to the commit before pushing.
Trails #248 and #249 were unassigned and so looked inactive until fixed.
open_items: Fix the #380 comparator so it no longer over-flags antd `string & Record<never, never>` rows, then re-merge. Do not merge #380 until the worker lands the fix.
Review and merge #379, #380, #384 and release PR #291 (0.10.0).

Resolver trail #255: Batch 1 (alias wrappers, call-signature-only types, opaque index keys) is running; Batch 2 (keyof typeof, -1 literal, indexed access, intersections, unbound type parameters) and Batch 3 (inline discriminated unions, per-prop opaque marker) are not started.
Scoping ADR 0025 leftovers: Branch 3 (switch case scope), Branch 5 (type-only imports), and the gap where non-indexed-access evaluator reads take no scope.
SPEC/AC tag re-scan in source comments, held until #379 merges.
Oracle `paths` support, unmeasured oracle areas, Spectrum's 20 checker-only props, and committing the ground-truth harness.
Branch decisions: open a PR for or delete `chore/changesets-for-merged-fixes`, and keep or delete `perf/cycles-by-structure`.
Worktrees: unlock the PID 18858 locks if stale; decide on `agent-a482304b1a114609f` (old resolver edits) and `agent-a8cdaa39c9352581f` (unchecked); check `agent-a67a67ece3aaa85b9` (unpushed commit).
Delete or keep /tmp/claude-501/oracle-rerun/ (corpora, caches, and installed pnpm versions).
Callisto #442: the test harness never records the pushed tag.
Decide whether to keep `ReactElement` collapsed to `reactNode` (recommended) or add a distinct terminal.
